$comment: SCOPE: this registry carries only facts that are deterministic from source inspection -
event type, status, domain, store, actor, target, writer, surface reachability, and notification
mapping. It deliberately does NOT duplicate user-facing copy strings. Copy lives in exactly one
place (the label maps in code) and is transcribed in exactly one document (the Markdown matrix).
Duplicating it here would guarantee drift.
Use `docRef` to jump to the prose entry for triggers, evidence, and verbatim copy.

surfaceVocabulary.SHOWN: queried and rendered with a curated label
surfaceVocabulary.SHOWN_FALLBACK: rendered via generic title-case fallback, no curated label
surfaceVocabulary.HIDDEN_INTENTIONAL: stored on purpose but deliberately withheld from this surface
surfaceVocabulary.HIDDEN_NOT_QUERIED: excluded by a query allowlist; rows are never fetched
surfaceVocabulary.HIDDEN_FILTERED: fetched, then dropped by a post-query visibility filter
surfaceVocabulary.LABEL_ONLY: a label exists on this surface but the event is dead, so it can never render
surfaceVocabulary.INCLUDED: present in the CSV/export label map
surfaceVocabulary.NA: no such surface exists for this domain
